title: Potential estimate over a set of finite measure: ∫_S |w|^{1−n} ≤ (n+1)·ω^{1−1/n}·Lⁿ(S)^{1/n} (radius split of Step 5)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1, and let ω := Lⁿ(B_1(0)) ∈ (0,∞), as a real number. Let S ⊆ ℝⁿ = Eucl n be a Borel-measurable set (MeasurableSet S) with Lⁿ(S) < ∞, and write L := Lⁿ(S) ∈ [0,∞), as a real number. Then w ↦ (|w|^m)⁻¹ is integrable on S, and ∫_S (|w|^m)⁻¹ dw ≤ (m + 2)·ω^{m/(m+1)}·L^{1/(m+1)} (real powers).
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (S : Set (Eucl (m + 1))), MeasurableSet S → volume S ≠ ⊤ → IntegrableOn (fun t : Eucl (m + 1) => (‖t‖ ^ m)⁻¹) S ∧ ∫ t in S, (‖t‖ ^ m)⁻¹ ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 2) * (volume (ball (0 : Eucl (m + 1)) 1)).toReal ^ ((m : ℝ) / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) * (volume S).toReal ^ ((1 : ℝ) / ((m : ℝ) + 1))
